cohort: Nonsmoking Chinese women, aged >18 years, with singleton pregnancies, classified as overweight or obese (BMI 24-28 kg/m2), and with uncomplicated pregnancies at <12(+6) weeks gestation
finding: Cycling exercise initiated early in pregnancy (at least 30 minutes, 3 times per week) was associated with a significant reduction in the frequency of gestational diabetes mellitus in overweight/obese pregnant women.
birth_weight: Infants born to women in the exercise group had a significantly lower birth weight compared to those in the control group (3345.27 ± 397.07 vs 3457.46 ± 446.00 g; P = .049).
